build_doc_builder_docs: build documentation for a Python library from markdown source files using the doc_builder build command
build_html_docs: build HTML documentation from MDX source files with SvelteKit rendering and node-based build pipeline
create_build_parser: create an argparse parser for the doc_builder build command with library name, version, and output directory options
check_node_version: check that node v14 or higher is installed before building HTML documentation
update_versions_file: update the _versions.yml file in the build output directory after a successful documentation build
